subject: alt-c-pg
title: (R)ALT.C.PROG.------TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 343 (PCC-27). ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. The title names ALT-C-PROG; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INT: COS-AGN (cosmic assignment). SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is on a dotted line from INT. From COS-AGN: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: MTA-IMP (meta-implications), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From MTA-IMP: RT-IMP (reality implications).
